Fulhadhoo Guest Houses: Compare Rooms, Prices and Beach Stays

Compare Fulhadhoo Guest houses, boutique hotels, a dive-focused stay and a private villa by room type, family suitability, dining, pool access, beach location and live total cost. HolidayVibe can coordinate the room, taxes, meals, transfer and excursions in one itemised quote.

Choosing a Fulhadhoo guest house, in short. Fulhadhoo has value Guest houses, mid-range stays, boutique hotels, a dive-focused hotel, a beach cottage and a private four-bedroom villa. Indicative rates start from around USD 65 a night and rise with room type and comfort; the final price changes by date, occupancy, meal plan and cancellation terms, so confirm the all-in total rather than relying on the starting rate alone. All stays sit on the same compact island, but "beachfront" does not always mean directly beside the designated western bikini beach, so confirm the actual walking time and which shore a property faces. Breakfast is available at most stays and may be included in selected rates; confirm the exact meal plan before booking. Many properties can help enquire about local reef trips and seasonal Hanifaru Bay excursions, though operation and wildlife sightings are subject to confirmation. Fulhadhoo is a dry local island, so no alcohol is sold or served.

MealsBreakfast in selected rates

How Fulhadhoo Accommodation Prices Work

There is no reliable island-wide tariff, and a low headline rate can end up more expensive once meals, taxes and transfer are added. Compare the total, not the starting number.

What to confirm in every Fulhadhoo accommodation quote.
Price componentWhat to confirm
Rate unitPer room, per person or whole villa
OccupancySingle, double, family or group
Meal planRoom only, breakfast, half board or full board
Tourism GST17% since 1 July 2025, included or added
Green TaxUSD 6 per tourist per day for local-island guest houses with 50 or fewer registered rooms; children under two are exempt
Service chargeIncluded or added
Extra bedAdult or child rate
TransferOne-way, return or excluded
CancellationFlexible or non-refundable

The one figure to ask for. Room + meal plan + 17% TGST + Green Tax + return transfer + any child or extra-bed charge = your real stay total. A room that is USD 10 cheaper a night is not cheaper overall once transfer, meals and child fares are added. See the Malé to Fulhadhoo speedboat transfer guide.

Beach Access, Bedding and What to Confirm

One honest note on location wording: nearly every listing describes itself as beachfront or a short walk from the bikini beach, which on an island under 2 km long is true of almost everywhere, and "beachfront" can mean a different shoreline rather than the designated western bikini beach. Before booking, ask which shore the property faces, how many minutes on foot to the start of the bikini zone, whether the room faces the beach side, and whether bicycles or beach loungers are provided. Our Fulhadhoo bikini beach guide explains the beach itself.

Families and groups need more than a "family room" tick, so confirm the existing bed configuration, the maximum adults and children, extra-bed and cot availability and charges, the child meal rate, and whether rooms connect. For Villa Mia, confirm the whole-villa occupancy and rate rather than a per-room price.

Cancellation and Payment

Terms vary by property and by the rate you choose, so confirm these before you pay: whether a deposit is required and how much; whether the balance is paid before arrival or locally; whether cards are accepted and if a surcharge applies; what happens to your room if the speedboat is cancelled or your flight changes; whether the booking can move to another date; and the no-show policy. A flexible rate costs a little more but protects you against Maldives weather and transfer disruption.

Fulhadhoo Guest House FAQ

How much does it cost to stay on Fulhadhoo?

There is no reliable island-wide tariff. The rate depends on the date, room type, occupancy, meal plan, taxes and cancellation terms, and it may be quoted per room, per person or as a whole-villa price. Ask for one itemised total including 17% TGST, Green Tax and any transfer before comparing stays.

Is tax included in Fulhadhoo guest house prices?

Not always. Confirm whether the quote includes 17% Tourism GST (in force since 1 July 2025), Green Tax of USD 6 per tourist per day, and any service charge. Children under two are exempt from Green Tax.

Is breakfast included?

Breakfast is available at most Fulhadhoo stays and is included in selected rates, but this varies by property and by the offer you book. Confirm the exact meal plan in writing before booking.

Which Fulhadhoo guest house is best for families?

Ahiva Village, Three Hearts, Jazeeraa Beach Stay and Island Luxury Dive are useful starting points, and Villa Mia works as a whole villa for a larger group. Confirm the exact family-room or villa occupancy and bedding before booking.

Which property is best for a private group?

Villa Mia is a four-bedroom private villa with a private pool and kitchen, booked as a whole villa rather than by the room, which suits families or groups wanting shared space. Confirm the whole-villa rate and maximum guests.

Which Fulhadhoo property has a pool?

Island Luxury Boutique advertises a rooftop pool, Island Luxury Dive lists pool-club access, and Villa Mia describes a private pool. Confirm current pool access for your dates.

Which guest house is best for diving?

Island Luxury Dive is the clearest dive-focused stay, and Island Luxury Boutique advertises access to the same dive operation. Confirm the current dive-centre operation, packages, equipment and no-fly day.

Are Fulhadhoo guest houses beside the bikini beach?

Some are close, but "beachfront" does not always mean directly beside the designated western bikini zone, since a property can face another shoreline. Ask for the actual walking time to the bikini beach before booking.

How do I get to Fulhadhoo from Malé?

Most guests take a shared speedboat of about 2 hours, up to 2.5 depending on route and sea, usually via Goidhoo and Fehendhoo, or a domestic flight to Dharavandhoo followed by a boat. Confirm the current fare, schedule and child policy for your date.

Is Fulhadhoo a dry island?

Yes. As an inhabited local island under Maldivian law, Fulhadhoo does not sell or serve alcohol, and guest houses are not licensed to do so. Dress modestly away from the designated bikini beach.

Should I book before arriving?

Yes, especially for family rooms, twin rooms, private villas, dive packages and peak-season dates. Fulhadhoo properties are small, so a required room category can sell out while the property still appears available.

Can HolidayVibe book a guest house and transfer together?

Yes. We combine the room, meal plan, taxes, return speedboat and any requested excursions into one itemised quotation, and confirm room availability, bedding and cancellation terms before you pay. HolidayVibe is a Ministry of Tourism licensed agency in Malé.
